body:
Blocked-by: #14295

## Why this card exists (multi-repo rule 3: the accepting seat files the consumer-side follow-up)

The objectui fixes accepted from the 2026-09-02 dogfood dispatch have landed on objectui `main`, but the console this repo ships is whatever `.objectui-sha` names — a merged objectui PR reaches no ObjectStack user until the pin moves:

| objectui PR | card | landed |
|---|---|---|
| #7284 | objectui#7245 — synthesized default list view leads with the object's `nameField` | 2026-09-02 09:35Z |
| #7288 | objectui#7244 — record header title keeps a width floor; the action tail wraps | 2026-09-02 09:36Z |

More P1/P2 fixes from the same dispatch are in flight (objectui#7246 fields `[Object]`, #7247 axis labels, #7248 scatter, #7249 inbox polling, #7250 page charts); refresh the table on this card as they merge rather than filing one card per PR.

## What to do (reader: the seat that moves the console pin — devx@objectstack, or whoever lands #14295)

1. Wait for #14295 (pin `d8ec8d6d` → `67dadd602a3a`) to land — it carries the four gated halves of a bump for that hop (sdui:manifest ratchet, pin-citation re-measure, sdui-parser lockstep record, sdui.manifest record) and this card starts from its tip.
2. Bump again to the objectui `main` tip that includes every merged row above: `OBJECTUI_ROOT=<objectui checkout> bash scripts/bump-objectui.sh <sha>` (from a nested worktree `../objectui` does not resolve — pass the root explicitly), then the same four halves: `pnpm sdui:manifest`, `check:objectui-pin-citations` (re-READ every anchor at the new pin, never sha-swap), `OBJECTUI_ROOT=.cache/objectui-<sha12> pnpm gen:sdui-lockstep`, `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs --objectui-version <objectui packages/core version at the pin>`.
3. Verify in the browser on the rebuilt console (dogfood skill): the Account default list shows the name column first; a Field Zoo record header shows its full title at ≤820px.

Unblocks when #14295 is merged; the label/state is `pm:blocked` until then.
